card.fact_statement: The 14-day period for the second phase of the Chancellor election lasted until 20 May.
card.source_span: within a period of 14 days, i.e. until 20 May, a quarter of the members of the Bundestag could nominate a candidate for election as Federal Chancellor.

target_qa_variants.question: Bis zu welchem Datum lief die 14-tägige Frist für die zweite Phase der Kanzlerwahl, bevor das Kabinett Merz gebildet wurde?
target_qa_variants.source_span: within a period of 14 days, i.e. until 20 May, a quarter of the members of the Bundestag could nominate a candidate for election as Federal Chancellor.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'last' as 'lief' (ran) which is more natural for deadlines/periods in German. Mapped 'May 20' to the numeric date format '20.05.' as an alias.

backtranslation_en.question: Until what date did the 14-day period for the second phase of the chancellor election run before the Merz cabinet was formed?
